docs.title: What is My First Coding (MFC)?
docs.text: My First Coding is a free, online learning platform that teaches computer programming and software development developed by Blue-Cannon organization in GitHub. This teach who are begginers and/or who don't know to code. Start From Level 0 to Level Up! Now, This can teach you how to code in all devices you have. Inspired by freeCodeCamp and Khan Academy but it explains, memorize, troubleshooting, use it. Just stop using AI Coding and is not allowed.

docs.title: On Android
docs.text:
1. Open Chrome app.
  2. Tap the Address URL Bar and type https://blue-cannon.github.io/my-first-coding
  3. Find the Link "GetS"
